title: Puttering Pebble Ray
statement: A palm-sized, midnight-blue ray with translucent, apricot-edged fins putters through a spacious tank of white sand, basalt arches, and wavering amber light, blowing little jets of water to arrange bright pebbles into constellations. Whenever a pattern becomes too tidy, it burrows underneath and erupts in a small, apparently satisfying sandstorm.
